//AllowedHosts: Host header allowlist. '*' accepts any Host, which lets an attacker poison absolute URLs the app builds from the request. Override per environment (AllowedHosts env var) with the real hostnames.

Cors.//AllowedOrigins: Browser origins allowed to call the API cross-origin (e.g. the public site, which has no dev-proxy). Covers the public site, the investor app and the admin dashboard.

//SECRETS: Every secret below is intentionally BLANK. Supply real values through the environment (double-underscore keys, e.g. Jwt__SigningKey) or a secret store — never by editing this file, which is committed. SecretsGuard rejects startup in Production if any of them is blank or a known placeholder. See appsettings.Example.json for the shape of each value.

Database.//MigrateOnStartup: Apply EF migrations on startup. Enabled in docker-compose; keep false where you run migrations explicitly.
Database.//SeedOnStartup: Seed demo tokenization objects (Properties) when the table is empty. Dev/demo only — keep false in production.

Jwt.//SigningKey: HS256 key. Base64 of 32 random bytes: openssl rand -base64 32

Media.//: Public media (property photos/documents). Files are copied to ScpHost:{RemoteRoot}/{category}/{uuid.ext} over SCP; the persisted URL is {PublicBaseUrl}{PublicBasePath}/{category}/{uuid.ext}, served by that host's nginx. Set ScpHost/Username and ScpPassword (or ScpPrivateKeyPath) via env (Media__*); password is a secret.

Encryption.//Key: AES-256-GCM key for PII at rest. Base64 of 32 random bytes: openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it makes existing ciphertext unreadable — rotate deliberately.

Otp.//HashPepper: Server-side pepper for the stored OTP hash. Base64 of 32 random bytes: openssl rand -base64 32. Must differ from Encryption:Key.

NikitaPro.//: Login and ApiKey are secrets — supply them via env vars (NikitaPro__Login / NikitaPro__ApiKey) or a .env file, never commit real values here.
